from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section7Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        title = "The Unified Summary"
        lines = [
            "- All three operations live within this single triangle.",
            "- Rotating our focus reveals powers, roots, or logs.",
            "- The numbers two, three, and eight never move.",
            "- One consistent map for all exponential math.",
            "- Mathematics becomes simpler when we see the connections."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)
        
        # Define colors for lecture lines
        line_colors = [BLUE_B, GREEN_B, YELLOW_B, GOLD_B, PURPLE_B]
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(line_colors[0]))
        
        # Vertices positions: Bottom-Left (D2), Top (B3), Bottom-Right (D4)
        v_base_pos = self.grid["D2"]
        v_exp_pos = self.grid["B3"]
        v_pow_pos = self.grid["D4"]
        
        triangle = Polygon(v_base_pos, v_exp_pos, v_pow_pos, color=WHITE, stroke_width=4)
        
        # Vertex Values
        val_base = MathTex("2", color=BLUE_B)
        val_exp = MathTex("3", color=GREEN_B)
        val_pow = MathTex("8", color=RED_B)
        
        self.place_at_grid(val_base, "D2", scale_factor=1.2)
        self.place_at_grid(val_exp, "B3", scale_factor=1.2)
        self.place_at_grid(val_pow, "D4", scale_factor=1.2)
        
        self.play(Create(triangle), Write(val_base), Write(val_exp), Write(val_pow))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(line_colors[1])
        )
        
        # Operations labels
        label_power = MathTex("2^3 = 8", font_size=24, color=YELLOW_B)
        self.place_at_grid(label_power, "E3", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        label_root = MathTex(r"\sqrt[3]{8} = 2", font_size=24, color=ORANGE)
        self.place_at_grid(label_root, "C1", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        label_log = MathTex(r"\log_2(8) = 3", font_size=24, color=PURPLE_B)
        self.place_at_grid(label_log, "C5", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        # Pulse edges
        self.play(triangle.animate.set_stroke(width=8, color=GREEN_B), run_time=0.4)
        self.play(triangle.animate.set_stroke(width=4, color=WHITE), run_time=0.4)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(label_power), FadeIn(label_root), FadeIn(label_log))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(line_colors[2])
        )
        
        # Highlight symmetry by rotating slightly
        tri_group = VGroup(triangle, val_base, val_exp, val_pow, label_power, label_root, label_log)
        center_point = tri_group.get_center()
        
        self.play(
            Rotate(tri_group, angle=15*DEGREES, about_point=center_point),
            run_time=0.8,
            rate_func=wiggle
        )
        
        # Pulse the numbers
        self.play(
            Indication(val_base, color=BLUE_B),
            Indication(val_exp, color=GREEN_B),
            Indication(val_pow, color=RED_B)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.play(
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(line_colors[3])
        )
        
        # Scale to fill the frame
        # Transform the core triangle and numbers to a larger size in the area
        core_group = VGroup(triangle, val_base, val_exp, val_pow)
        large_group = core_group.copy()
        self.place_in_area(large_group, "A1", "F6", scale_factor=2.0)
        
        self.play(
            ReplacementTransform(core_group, large_group),
            FadeOut(label_power), FadeOut(label_root), FadeOut(label_log)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.play(
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[4].animate.set_color(line_colors[4])
        )
        
        # Final indication and fade out
        self.play(Indication(large_group, scale_factor=1.1))
        self.play(
            FadeOut(large_group),
            FadeOut(self.lecture),
            FadeOut(self.title)
        )
        self.wait(2)
